intent: Sensitivity screen only. Quantify how a small preregistered perturbation envelope around the mechanism-derived v2 component priors moves the per-tract score distribution, so candidate uncertainty is transparent before any authorized evaluation. Nothing is promoted, ranked, selected or uploaded.
disposition: sensitivity screen only; no promotion, no ranking, no submission, no upload

central_priors.note: These are the mechanism-derived v2 scalars carried by the frozen estimator, not leaderboard-derived values. They are declared here verbatim before any variant is computed.

perturbation_rule.kind: fixed multiplicative relative perturbation of the prior scalar only

applies_to.building_gap: the emitted building gap becomes clip(building_gap_central * factor, 0, 1) on defined rows
applies_to.establishments_cbp_k: gap recomputed as clip(1 - all_overture_poi_count / (factor * cbp_k * pop_total), 0, 1); the zero-population branch keeps gap 0
applies_to.facility_presence_prior_probability: p_variant = clip(p_central * factor, 0, 1); because the frozen family gap is p * clip(1 - n/(n+1), 0, 1) with the prior entering multiplicatively and n unchanged, the emitted family gap is scaled by p_variant / p_central
applies_to.facility_presence_prior_coefficient: one coefficient of one family's logistic prior is multiplied by the factor, p is recomputed with the frozen formula, and the emitted family gap is scaled by p_variant / p_central

never_perturbed: any provided-feature input (Overture counts, road kilometres, population, land area)
every model-defined flag and therefore every definedness mask
the transport component, which carries no prior
the combiners: equal-weight means over defined components only
perturbation_rule.presence_prior_reproduction_check: for tracts whose raw family counts and unclassified count are all zero the emitted family gap equals p_central exactly, which verifies the multiplicative transfer rule used for the presence-prior variants

strata.region: official region of the scored GEOID (four regions)
strata.urban_rural: urban when the frozen urbanity value is >= 0.5, rural when < 0.5; the repo's provided-field rule pct_urban < 0.5 for rural, with the frozen pop_urban/pop_total then neutral-0.5 fallback
strata.tribal: provided tribal_any boolean (1 true, 0 false, null unknown); values outside the boolean domain abort the audit

measurement.primary_metric: maximum absolute per-tract |score_variant - score_baseline| over the 9,379 official scored GEOIDs, per variant
measurement.secondary_metric: mean absolute per-tract delta and the same mean delta within region, urban/rural and tribal strata, per variant
measurement.envelope: per-tract minimum and maximum score across all preregistered variants, plus the envelope width distribution
measurement.no_winner_policy: every preregistered variant is reported with identical fields; the report emits no ranking, no best variant, no score-based ordering and no promotion decision

provided_strata.role: provided ACS strata covariates, used only to recompute the frozen presence prior and to assign the urban/rural and tribal strata

transport_component.perturbation_reason: The transport component is a pure ratio of two provided Overture road measures with no mechanism-derived prior, so no prior perturbation is defined for it and its per-tract delta is exactly zero.

presence_prior_transfer_verification.rule: for tracts whose raw family counts and unclassified count are all zero the emitted family gap equals p_central exactly, which verifies the multiplicative transfer rule used for the presence-prior variants

baseline_variant_vs_frozen_emitted_compo.note: The baseline variant applies no perturbation, so this residual is the 12-significant-digit round-trip floor of the frozen component artifacts, measured independently by the mask audit at 1.85e-12.

scope.central_score_reference: the composite emitted by the frozen artifacts for each tract
scope.candidate_note: No assembled v2 candidate CSV exists yet; the envelope is measured on the frozen component artifacts' own composite, which is the same arithmetic a candidate is emitted with. Rerun unchanged after candidate generation.

no_selection.ordering: variants are emitted in preregistered grid order, never by score
no_selection.note: every preregistered variant is reported with identical fields; the report emits no ranking, no best variant, no score-based ordering and no promotion decision

reproducibility.command: uv run --with pyarrow==26.0.0 --with numpy==2.5.4 --with pyproj==3.8.0 --with shapely==2.2.0 python scripts/audit_v2_prior_envelope.py --workspace "$COMPETITION_WORKSPACE" --out reports/v2-prior-envelope.json
